$description: Datum design tokens. Generated from Figma by scripts/build-tokens.mjs; do not edit by hand. Format: W3C Design Tokens Format Module 2025.10. Light is the default; dark values live in $extensions["io.github.sytnykk.datum"].modes.

875.$description: selected (dark); sits between surface and border

selected.$description: Selected row, item or tab. Neutral, never the accent. Sits between surface and border so dividers stay visible

accent.$description: Links and accent text on bg/default or bg/surface

ring.$description: Focus ring border. Own token even though it shares the accent hue

control-lg.$description: Large controls; candidate for phone widths (decide in Stage 3)

lg.$description: Section titles, dialog titles. Geist SemiBold 20/28.

sm.$description: Group headings, table section titles. Geist SemiBold 14/20.
Default UI text, table cells. Geist Regular 13/20.

xs.$description: Helper text, dense metadata. Geist Regular 12/16.

md.$description: Buttons, inputs, tabs, form labels. Geist Medium 13/20.

sm.$description: Compact controls, badges, table headers. Geist Medium 12/16.

caption.$description: Chart axes, timestamps. Smallest size; use sparingly. Geist Regular 11/16.

xl.$description: KPI values, e.g. 182 ms. Geist Mono Medium 28/36.

md.$description: Numbers in tables, IDs, code. Geist Mono Regular 13/20.

sm.$description: Inline code, compact numbers. Geist Mono Regular 12/16.
